scope: The exact 17 Phase 1 manual-review rows only.
objective: Freeze explicit reviewed dispositions using deterministic repo evidence without weakening the Phase 1 identity policy.
authoritative_approval_rules: A Phase 1 manual row may be approved only if the current repo snapshot now supplies exactly one position-compatible Sleeper candidate with exact normalized team corroboration.

A Phase 1 manual row may also be approved if the existing production identity_crosswalk already contains the exact same FantasyPros-to-Sleeper pair as a non-manual authoritative mapping and the current positions remain compatible.
A free-agent or missing-team state is not team corroboration.
A position-incompatible candidate is never approved by this phase.
No new team alias or position-compatibility rule may be invented in this phase.
collision_rule: No two approved FantasyPros IDs may map to the same Sleeper ID. Any collision is a hard stop.
promotion_rule: This phase cannot promote or mutate scripts/identity_crosswalk.json even if all rows are approved.
